a1222e5fef75.text: Morning, doc. Checklist first, then coffee. The view's on the bridge, not in here.

de24bf83c300.text: Seals, fuel, transponder. She's a good little boat. I'll wave when I go past the window.

9fe586872801.text: Still here, doc. Topping up the tanks, and my nerves.

8ad2034aafdd.text: I'm fine in here. Go on, the window's yours.

a3d459d908bc.text: And not while I'm prepping the capsule, please. I'd like the ship where I left it.

4f3e17f75889.text: Morning, doc! You slept through the arrival. Come up to the bridge, the view is ridiculous.

a61eb1417a4e.text: Isn't it something? That black circle is Erebus. Well, its shadow. I'm out in the capsule bay doing pre-flight.

9b6e655b9f6f.text: I can hear it from the bay. Steady as a metronome.

4f582ae42cd7.text: Then what am I looking at? It's still there on the screen, right at the edge.

eddfdfdc3eef.text: ...and now it's gone from the screen too. And the tone slid right down into nothing.

55a27abed970.text: My turn. I'm taking the capsule out to sample the disk light. Back in twenty minutes.

2ed6d820cc32.text: Bay doors opening. Watch the port side, doc.

c5b5889748b6.text: Engine's lit! I felt that. I'm climbing. I'm coming home!

82c3fb4af807.text: You know what scares me? On your screen I looked fine the whole time. If you'd waited until I looked like I was in trouble...

60fa96baefe0.text: Lost main power. Everything's dead except the radio and the backup engine. I'm drifting in.

8d2c81e3205d.text: Don't fire yet! The spectrometer's on battery. This is the best data anyone will ever get.

4b893e025bcf.text: You should see the ring from here. It's getting bigger.

4c81fa0b52d9.text: Halfway to the edge of the shadow, I think. The data's beautiful.

be6d0ebd0d40.text: Doc, the stars behind me are going blue. Is that right?

a8c476e7de6a.text: Still okay. Still waiting. Don't fire yet.

7c9be77b3403.text: Everything overhead is so bright I can barely read the instruments.

b30b4b1fb647.text: The black fills most of the window now.

c172a4e349b5.text: I can't tell if you've fired.

8bde0f152729.text: It doesn't look like anything. There's no edge.

b359556157dd.text: Every time I look, I find another thin arc of light in that ring.

6924293038e8.text: Taking a minute, doc? Don't blame you. I can still feel the floor dropping away.

11fb9f7bb845.text: I want to see that again. Without dying this time.

3e3218a3cd49.text: The window's gone completely black. WREN, is the camera broken?

666d3990026a.text: Okay. That's enough. Take us back up.

d218311f6367.text: One probe left. Orpheus. It has a camera, and it streams.

9d0dbfa0ce32.text: There it goes. The shadow's bigger every frame.

642634cedd9a.text: When it passes the depth where we hovered, will its picture go all black, like our window did?
642634cedd9a.pattern: ^When\ it\ passes\ .+?\ rₛ,\ where\ we\ hovered,\ will\ its\ picture\ go\ all\ black\ like\ our\ window\ did\?$

6c0f7d979b98.text: So that last frame is all we get. Did it fall in, or is it stuck there?

bf4446ba7bb9.text: So "frozen" is just what it looks like from here.

173890e7ef35.text: And the rest of the trip, the part inside... nobody out here will ever see it.

77accf2fab95.text: WREN worked it out for me. At the horizon, the tide from head to toe would have been 0.15 g. A gentle stretch, nothing more.

3e3ac27f94b4.text: And if I had crossed? WREN says the longest anyone can last inside Erebus is 1.9 seconds, by their own watch. Then the centre.

1f89411707d6.text: Less than two seconds. Somehow that's worse than forever.

472815c8235c.text: Next time I go out, you're on the beam. Nobody else.

c62528396f99.text: Go look at the window, doc. I'm fine. Really.

d0c8226f75ea.text: Still here. Go on, the window's yours.

3a509cecc3d8.text: Light going in a circle. Okay, doc, I have to see that.

95b1baa77a41.text: Wait. So any light that leaves the ship sideways comes back round to us?

aa2f5a7a5c20.text: So if I look straight along the hull, right at the edge of the shadow...

79744d1faa55.text: That is the creepiest thing I've heard all week. And I nearly fell into a black hole this morning.

f41a99eada89.text: Like balancing a pencil on its point. Okay. I've seen light go in a circle. Take us home, doc.
